card.name: The mg after a recommended dose number
card.fires_on: The unit mg right after a dose number in a 'recommended dosage of X is ___ mg' sentence, as in dosage sections of drug labels. Weaker, scattered hits on unrelated words in general web text.

modes.label: mg after recommended dose
modes.description: The unit mg following a number in a statement of the recommended dosage, just before the route and frequency.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of ORSERDU is 345<< mg>> taken orally with food once daily until disease

modes.label: Dose table entries
modes.description: The unit mg after a number in a dosing table or schedule.
modes.example: Patients >12 years of age and >40 kg 62.5<< mg>> twice daily 125 mg twice

modes.label: Stray web-text hits
modes.description: Occasional unrelated words in general text, such as 'it' or 'The' in an encyclopedic sentence.
modes.example: the county has a population of 9,818,605, making<< it>> the most populous county in the United States
